confidence_notes: Jeju cost-of-living data was last updated 2026-10-02 and is based on 20 entries from 5 contributors. Meal, cappuccino, and beer anchors use those local averages; cocktail and restaurant wine are inferred from the local beer price and typical bar markups. Accommodation is holistic and season-sensitive.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; local Jeju food and drink data anchors the estimates, while lodging reflects a broad Jeju tourism-market estimate.
